title: Extreme Cold
description: Plain-text reference on wind chill, hypothermia stages, and frostbite, with layering and body-heat conservation. Covers making a warm room without heat, surviving if stranded in a vehicle or caught outside, recognizing and responding to cold emergencies, and a winter vehicle kit.
shortDescription: Wind chill, layering, warm rooms, and treating hypothermia and frostbite
